subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Bait and Switch
description: A quick, practical guide to The Bait and Switch.

hook.text: An unbeatable deal lures you in. Once you arrive, the deal is gone — but something pricier awaits.

buildup.text: Bait and switch uses an attractive offer to get you committed, then substitutes a worse deal.

discovery.text: Car dealers, electronics stores, and contractors have all been caught using this technique.

twist.text: By the time you realize the switch, you've invested time and emotional energy — making you stay.

climax.text: The Federal Trade Commission has rules against bait and switch, but enforcement is limited.

punchline.text: The deal that brought you in was never real.

quiz.question: What is a bait and switch?
options: Luring customers with a deal then substituting something worse
